_description: Credits and licensing metadata for all game assets, textures, and sounds. Look up an asset by matching its path against the 'mappings' patterns to find the source entry in 'sources'.

poly-haven.name: Poly Haven
poly-haven.notes: All textures on Poly Haven are CC0. Attribution appreciated but not required. Search assets by the filename stem (e.g. 'aerial_beach_01') on the site.
poly-haven.identification: Texture filenames use the pattern {name}_{ao|arm|diff|disp|nor_gl|rough}_{1k|2k|4k}.{jpg|png|exr}. That naming convention is Poly Haven's standard.

poly-pizza.name: Poly Pizza
poly-pizza.license: Varies per asset (mostly CC0 or CC-BY)
poly-pizza.notes: Poly Pizza aggregates free 3D models from many creators (Quaternius, Kay Lousberg, Kenney, Jeremiah, and many others). Files downloaded from Poly Pizza typically get a random 8-to-12-character ID appended to the filename (e.g. 'Crystal-3saqXqoOti.glb', 'Large Building-1bt4yYKmuK.glb'). The license depends on the original creator. Search the model on poly.pizza to confirm. Most kits here are by Quaternius (CC0) or Kay Lousberg (CC0).
poly-pizza.identification: Folders ending in '-glb' and files with a dash followed by an 8-to-12-character random ID are Poly Pizza downloads.

quaternius.name: Quaternius
quaternius.notes: Quaternius releases low-poly 3D model packs under CC0. Attribution is appreciated but not required. His packs are commonly distributed through both quaternius.com and poly.pizza. Supporting him on Patreon (https://www.patreon.com/quaternius) unlocks early access.
quaternius.identification: Named packs such as 'Ultimate Modular Men/Women Pack', 'Ultimate Space Kit', 'Ultimate Food Pack', 'Ultimate Guns Pack', 'Ultimate Interior Props Pack', 'Stylized Nature MegaKit', 'Animal Kit', 'City Kit', 'Pirate Kit', 'Survival Kit', 'Platform Kit Revamped', 'FPS Pack', 'Small Platformer Kit', 'Small Camping Bundle', 'Cube World Kit', 'Race Kit', 'Scifi Turrets', '100 Avatars'.

kay-lousberg.name: Kay Lousberg (Kay Kit / KayKit)
kay-lousberg.notes: Kay Lousberg releases stylized low-poly kits as CC0 on kaylousberg.com and itch.io (https://kaykit.itch.io/). Credit is optional but appreciated.
kay-lousberg.identification: Packs like 'Cosmetic Pack Two', 'Exploded Card Pack', 'Signs Pack', 'Crystal Pack', 'City Pack', 'Furniture Kit', 'Office Pack', 'Premium Models' are likely Kay Lousberg (verify on kaylousberg.com).

kenney.name: Kenney (Kenney.nl)
kenney.notes: Kenney provides a huge library of game assets (3D models, 2D sprites, audio) under CC0. Some packs here (Hex Kit, Weapons Pack, Wood Frame Base Build Set) may be Kenney - verify on kenney.nl.
kenney.identification: Packs such as 'Hex Kit', 'Wood Frame Base Build Set', 'Weapons Pack In Case Of Zombies' are Kenney-style kits (verify on kenney.nl).

mixamo.name: Mixamo (Adobe)
mixamo.license: Adobe Mixamo Terms — free for commercial use with an Adobe account. No redistribution of raw assets.
mixamo.notes: Mixamo animations and characters are free for use (including commercially) as long as you have an Adobe ID. You cannot redistribute the raw FBX files as-is (must be used in a project). Characters downloaded include: alien, archer, arissa, ely, eve, exo, ganfaul, heraklios, kachujin, michelle, ninja, paladin, pirate, special-ops, vanguard, wildling, x-bot, y-bot.
mixamo.identification: Files in 3D/fbx/mixamo/ and the xbot.glb model at root glb.

adobe-fuse.name: Adobe Fuse CC (discontinued)
adobe-fuse.license: Adobe Fuse Terms — free for commercial use in projects; the product is discontinued but previously generated characters remain usable.
adobe-fuse.notes: Adobe Fuse was discontinued in 2020. Characters created with Fuse and rigged through Mixamo remain usable in projects but cannot be redistributed as raw files.

cmu-mocap.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
cmu-mocap.license: Free for any use. See database terms.
cmu-mocap.notes: The CMU mocap database is freely usable. Files are typically named like '01_01.fbx' where the first number is the subject and the second is the trial. Re-targeted versions for Mixamo-compatible skeletons are widely distributed.
cmu-mocap.identification: Files under 3D/fbx/mocap-suit/ and 3D/gltf/mocap-suit/ with numeric {subject}_{trial}.{ext} naming.

sketchfab.name: Sketchfab
sketchfab.license: Varies per model (commercially usable CC0 or CC-BY only in this project)
sketchfab.notes: Each Sketchfab model has its own license stated on its page. Models downloaded as gltf/zip often include a license.txt with exact attribution text. Non-commercial licenses are excluded from this project.
sketchfab.identification: Snake_case filenames like fortnite_x_star_wars_encrypted_skin.glb, star_wars_x-wing.glb, and other Sketchfab-style slugs. Confirmed allowed folders in 3D/gltf/ carry their own license.txt.

freesound.name: Freesound.org
freesound.license: Varies per sound (CC0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-3.0, CC Sampling Plus, etc.)
freesound.notes: Freesound files are uploaded by individual users with varying CC licenses. Each sound must be looked up individually at https://freesound.org/s/{ID}/ where {ID} is the numeric prefix in the filename. _readme_and_license.txt files in some pack folders provide the exact license per sound.
freesound.identification: Sounds with the pattern {numeric-id}__{username}__{description}.{ext} come from Freesound. Example: '384912__ali_6868__arrow-impact-3.mp3' → https://freesound.org/s/384912/ by user ali_6868.

pixabay.name: Pixabay
pixabay.license: Pixabay Content License (free for commercial use, no attribution required)
pixabay.notes: Pixabay sounds and music are free for commercial use; attribution is not required. Files typically include a trailing numeric Pixabay asset ID. Lookup URL: https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/?id={id} (or browse the asset page directly).
pixabay.identification: Files named {slug}-{id}.mp3 with 4-to-7-digit id, and files prefixed with 'freesound_community-' (Pixabay's reupload account that re-hosts CC0 Freesound content).

kevin-macleod.name: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
kevin-macleod.license: CC-BY 4.0 (attribution required) or Kevin MacLeod's license if purchased
kevin-macleod.notes: Kevin MacLeod's royalty-free music is free for commercial use with attribution. Standard attribution format: '"{Song Title}" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) — Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/'. Verify each title at incompetech.com.
kevin-macleod.identification: Named music tracks with title-case filenames and no trailing numeric IDs: 'Ancient Winds.mp3', 'Bittersweet.mp3', 'Black Vortex.mp3', 'Clash Defiant.mp3', 'Comfortable Mystery 2.mp3', 'Corruption.mp3', 'Magic Forest.mp3', 'Midnight Tale.mp3', 'Peppers Theme.mp3', 'Stay the Course.mp3'.

unknown.name: Unknown / needs manual verification
unknown.notes: A handful of files don't match a known pattern. Verify each source before using commercially. Common fallbacks: search the filename on Google, Sketchfab, Poly Pizza, Freesound. CC0-prefixed filenames (e.g. 'cc0__smooth_hammerhead_shark.glb') are self-declared CC0 — still worth confirming the original upload.
